rationale: The prompt requires Retrieve captions for a video and provide both a timed subtitle file and a readable text version. Prefer captions made by people. If no captions can be retrieved, tell me the estimated transcription download and wait for approval; the anchored # YouTube Transcript Downloader explicitly scopes the source-visible workflow to Download YouTube video transcripts when user provides a YouTube URL or asks to download/get/fetch a transcript from YouTube. Also use when user wants to transcribe or get captions/subtitles from a YouTube video. That scope directly supports the requested input, transformation, and deliverable rather than leaving a material component unaddressed.
